# First Word

First Word
Input file: standard input
Output file: standard output
Time limit: 5 seconds
Memory limit: 1024 megabytes
VegiCat has a string S of n lowercase English letters. He wants to build a dictionary that contains k
distinct nonempty substrings of S as its words. A substring is a contiguous part of a string. Substrings
with the same content are treated as the same word, even if they occur at different positions in S.
Let π be a mapping from the letters a, b, . . . , z to the corresponding letters in a permutation of the
26 lowercase English letters. For example, the permutation qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm defines the
following mapping:
c a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z
π(c) q w e r t y u i o p a s d f g h j k l z x c v b n m
For a string u = u1u2 · · · um, define
π(u) = π(u1)π(u2)· · · π(um).
For example, with the mapping above, π(apple) = qhhst.
VegiCat wants the dictionary to contain a word w such that, after applying any such mapping π to every
word in the dictionary, π(w) is always the lexicographically smallest word in the resulting dictionary.
For each k = 1, 2, . . . , n, find the number of dictionaries that contain k distinct words and satisfy the
requirement, modulo 998244353.
Two dictionaries are considered different if and only if they contain different sets of words before any
mapping is applied.
Recall that string a is lexicographically smaller than string b if a is a prefix of b (and a ̸= b), or there
exists an index i (1 ≤ i ≤ min(|a|, |b|)) such that ai < bi
, and for any index j (1 ≤ j < i) aj = bj .
Input
The first line contains an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 104
), the number of test cases. The description of the test
cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105
).
The second line contains a string S of length n, consisting only of lowercase English letters.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 105
.
Output
For each test case, output n integers on one line. The k-th integer represents the number of dictionaries
that contain k distinct words and satisfy the requirement, modulo 998244353.
Example
standard input standard output
3
3
aab
4
ppqq
7
abcaabc
5 4 3
8 10 11 10
21 52 87 119 139 128 84
Page 1 of 2

Note
Each dictionary below is written as a set of words.
For the first test case, S = aab, the dictionaries that satisfy the requirement for k = 1, 2, 3 are:
k Word sets that satisfy the requirement Number of dictionaries
1 {a}, {b}, {aa}, {ab}, {aab} 5
2 {a, aa}, {a, ab}, {a, aab}, {aa, aab} 4
3 {a, aa, ab}, {a, aa, aab}, {a, ab, aab} 3
Page 2 of 2

# First Word

Time limit: 5 seconds. Memory limit: 1024 megabytes. Standard input and output.

VegiCat has a string $S$ of $n$ lowercase English letters. He wants a dictionary containing $k$ distinct nonempty substrings of $S$ as words. A substring is a contiguous part of a string. Substrings with identical content are the same word even if they occur at different positions in $S$.

Let $\pi$ map the letters `a,b,...,z` to the corresponding letters of a permutation of the $26$ lowercase English letters. For example, `qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm` defines this mapping:

```text
c      a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z
pi(c)  q w e r t y u i o p a s d f g h j k l z x c v b n m
```

For a string $u=u_1u_2\cdots u_m$, define $\pi(u)=\pi(u_1)\pi(u_2)\cdots\pi(u_m)$. For the mapping above, $\pi(\mathtt{apple})=\mathtt{qhhst}$.

The dictionary must contain a word $w$ such that, for every such mapping $\pi$ applied to all dictionary words, $\pi(w)$ is the lexicographically smallest resulting word. The same word must satisfy this requirement for all mappings.

For each $k=1,2,\ldots,n$, count dictionaries containing $k$ distinct words and satisfying the requirement, modulo $998244353$. Two dictionaries differ exactly when their word sets before any mapping differ.

Recall that string $a$ is lexicographically smaller than string $b$ if $a$ is a proper prefix of $b$ ($a\ne b$), or there is an index $i$ ($1\le i\le\min(|a|,|b|)$) such that $a_i<b_i$ and $a_j=b_j$ for every $j$ ($1\le j<i$).

## Input Format

The first line contains $T$ ($1\le T\le10^4$), the number of test cases. Each test case has $n$ ($1\le n\le10^5$) on the first line and a string $S$ of length $n$, consisting only of lowercase English letters, on the second line. The sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $10^5$.

## Output Format

For each test case, output $n$ integers on one line. The $k$-th integer is the number of valid dictionaries with $k$ distinct words, modulo $998244353$.

## Sample Explanation

Write each dictionary as a set of words. In the first test case, $S=\mathtt{aab}$. The dictionaries for $k=1,2,3$ are:

| $k$ | Valid word sets | Number |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `{a}`, `{b}`, `{aa}`, `{ab}`, `{aab}` | 5 |
| 2 | `{a, aa}`, `{a, ab}`, `{a, aab}`, `{aa, aab}` | 4 |
| 3 | `{a, aa, ab}`, `{a, aa, aab}`, `{a, ab, aab}` | 3 |


## Sample 1

### Input

```text
3
3
aab
4
ppqq
7
abcaabc
```

### Output

```text
5 4 3
8 10 11 10
21 52 87 119 139 128 84
```

translation.markdown:
# 第一个单词

时间限制：5 秒。内存限制：1024 MB。使用标准输入和标准输出。

VegiCat 有一个由 $n$ 个小写英文字母组成的字符串 $S$。他想建立一本字典，其中的 $k$ 个单词是 $S$ 的互不相同的非空子串。子串是字符串中连续的一部分。即使出现在 $S$ 的不同位置，只要内容相同，就视为同一个单词。

令 $\pi$ 将字母 `a,b,...,z` 映射到 $26$ 个小写英文字母的某个排列中对应位置的字母。例如，排列 `qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm` 定义以下映射：

```text
c      a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z
pi(c)  q w e r t y u i o p a s d f g h j k l z x c v b n m
```

对于字符串 $u=u_1u_2\cdots u_m$，定义 $\pi(u)=\pi(u_1)\pi(u_2)\cdots\pi(u_m)$。在上述映射下，$\pi(\mathtt{apple})=\mathtt{qhhst}$。

字典中必须存在一个单词 $w$，使得对于任意这样的映射 $\pi$，将其应用于字典中的所有单词后，$\pi(w)$ 始终是所得字典中字典序最小的单词。必须由同一个单词对所有映射都满足这一要求。

对于每个 $k=1,2,\ldots,n$，计算包含 $k$ 个不同单词且满足要求的字典数量，对 $998244353$ 取模。两本字典不同，当且仅当它们在应用映射前包含的单词集合不同。

字符串 $a$ 的字典序小于字符串 $b$，当且仅当：$a$ 是 $b$ 的真前缀（$a\ne b$）；或者存在下标 $i$（$1\le i\le\min(|a|,|b|)$），满足 $a_i<b_i$，并且对于每个 $j$（$1\le j<i$）都有 $a_j=b_j$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含测试用例数 $T$（$1\le T\le10^4$）。每个测试用例的第一行包含 $n$（$1\le n\le10^5$），第二行包含长度为 $n$、仅由小写英文字母组成的字符串 $S$。所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，在一行中输出 $n$ 个整数。第 $k$ 个整数表示包含 $k$ 个不同单词的合法字典数量，对 $998244353$ 取模。

## 样例说明

下面将每本字典写作单词集合。第一组样例中，$S=\mathtt{aab}$。对于 $k=1,2,3$，合法字典如下：

| $k$ | 合法单词集合 | 数量 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `{a}`, `{b}`, `{aa}`, `{ab}`, `{aab}` | 5 |
| 2 | `{a, aa}`, `{a, ab}`, `{a, aab}`, `{aa, aab}` | 4 |
| 3 | `{a, aa, ab}`, `{a, aa, aab}`, `{a, ab, aab}` | 3 |


## 样例 1

### 输入

```text
3
3
aab
4
ppqq
7
abcaabc
```

### 输出

```text
5 4 3
8 10 11 10
21 52 87 119 139 128 84
```
